scope: Fresh immutable baseline workflow file readback after workspace maintenance; not a current CI pass

structuredContent.content:
name: A2-DYN summable physical-source native qualification
on:
  push:
    branches: ['revision/a2-dyn-summable-physical-source-2026-10-17']
    paths:
      - 'papers/A2-DYN-summable-physical-source-author-revision/**'
      - '.github/workflows/a2-dyn-summable-physical-source-20261017.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  native-source-checks-and-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          sparse-checkout: papers/A2-DYN-summable-physical-source-author-revision
      - name: Install real native build and audit dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended texlive-science lmodern poppler-utils python3-venv
          python3 -m venv /tmp/a2-dyn-native-venv
          /tmp/a2-dyn-native-venv/bin/python -m pip install -r papers/A2-DYN-summable-physical-source-author-revision/requirements.txt
          command -v pdflatex
          command -v pdfinfo
      - name: Run the exact checked-out native source
        working-directory: papers/A2-DYN-summable-physical-source-author-revision
        run: |
          git rev-parse HEAD
          /tmp/a2-dyn-native-venv/bin/python tools/qualify_revision.py all
      - name: Retain execution and failure records
        if: always()
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/a2-dyn-summable-physical-source-evidence
          git rev-parse HEAD > /tmp/a2-dyn-summable-physical-source-evidence/exact-checkout.txt
          git status --porcelain=v1 > /tmp/a2-dyn-summable-physical-source-evidence/post-run-status.txt
          tar -czf /tmp/a2-dyn-summable-physical-source-evidence/active-source-and-execution.tar.gz -C papers/A2-DYN-summable-physical-source-author-revision .
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: a2-dyn-summable-physical-source-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: /tmp/a2-dyn-summable-physical-source-evidence/*
          if-no-files-found: error
